## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I worked from a complete claimed task packet and preserved unrelated changes.
- [ ] I did not expose secrets, personal data, proprietary inputs, or evaluator-only benchmark material.
- [ ] I did not make generated views, runtime memory, agent output, or external trackers canonical.
- [ ] I mapped acceptance conditions to evidence and ran the required verification.
- [ ] I staged only task-related files and reviewed the diff.
- [ ] I separated findings/proposals from accepted knowledge changes.
